summary: As of mid-to-late 2026, ChatGPT/GPT models retain the largest consumer mindshare with 55.5% of generative AI web visits, but Gemini has surged to 25.6% and Claude to 9.3%, reflecting a rapidly fragmenting market. In enterprise API usage, Anthropic leads at 40% followed by OpenAI at 27% and Google at 21%, while open-weight models like Llama 4 and DeepSeek-V3 dominate self-hosted and on-premise deployments. Developer adoption increasingly spans multiple models simultaneously, with DeepSeek capturing 24.4% of OpenRouter text requests and Qwen adopted by over 90,000 enterprises.

models.name: GPT-5 / GPT-5.1
models.popularity_notes: ChatGPT commands 55.5% of global generative AI web visits as of August 2026 and OpenAI holds 27% of enterprise API usage, maintaining the largest single developer install base worldwide.
strengths: Broadest third-party ecosystem and plugin integrations
Strong general-purpose reasoning and instruction following
Extensive enterprise tooling and Azure integration
Largest developer community and documentation base
Consistent benchmark performance across diverse tasks
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise applications, coding assistants, and consumer-facing AI products requiring broad ecosystem support

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Gemini web visits surged to 2.9 billion in May 2026 (450% YoY growth) and holds 25.6% of global generative AI web traffic as of August 2026, driven by deep integration with Google Workspace and Android.
strengths: Industry-leading long-context window up to 1 million tokens
Native multimodal capabilities across text, image, audio, and video
Deep integration with Google Cloud and Workspace products
Highly competitive coding and reasoning performance
Strong multilingual support
models.best_for: Long-document analysis, multimodal enterprise workflows, and applications deeply integrated with Google Cloud infrastructure

models.name: Claude Opus 5 / Claude Fable 5.1
models.popularity_notes: Claude recorded 952.6 million web visits in May 2026 (855% YoY), holds 9.3% of global AI web traffic, and leads enterprise API adoption at 40% of the market per Menlo Ventures 2025 data.
strengths: Top score on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 66
Industry-leading safety and Constitutional AI alignment
Exceptional long-form reasoning and nuanced writing quality
Strong performance on complex coding and agentic tasks
Preferred by enterprises for compliance-sensitive deployments
models.best_for: Enterprise agentic workflows, legal and compliance document processing, and high-stakes reasoning tasks requiring reliable safety guarantees

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Llama remains the dominant open-weight model family by HuggingFace downloads, with Llama 4 cited as the leading self-hosted alternative for teams needing on-premise deployment across thousands of community fine-tunes.
strengths: Fully open weights enabling unrestricted fine-tuning and self-hosting
Massive ecosystem of community fine-tunes and tooling
Zero API cost when self-hosted
Strong baseline performance competitive with closed models
Broad hardware compatibility including consumer GPUs
models.best_for: Self-hosted and on-premise deployments, privacy-sensitive applications, and teams requiring full model customization without vendor lock-in

models.name: DeepSeek-V3
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek models captured 24.4% of all text requests on OpenRouter in the week of September 21, 2026, making them the most-used model family on the leading API-switching marketplace among developers.
strengths: Exceptional price-to-performance ratio among frontier-class models
High adoption on API aggregators and developer tooling platforms
Strong coding and mathematical reasoning capabilities
Open weights available for self-hosted deployment
Competitive benchmark scores against much more expensive closed models
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive developer projects, API-heavy applications requiring high throughput, and teams seeking open-weight frontier performance

models.name: Gemini Flash (2.5 / 3.5)
models.popularity_notes: Gemini Flash variants are noted for leading performance on specific coding tasks and are widely adopted as the go-to low-latency, high-throughput option within the Google ecosystem, contributing significantly to Gemini's overall 25.6% traffic share.
strengths: Best-in-class latency for a frontier-tier model
Very low cost enabling high-volume production use cases
Retains 1 million token context window from Pro tier
Strong coding task performance noted in independent evaluations
Ideal for real-time and streaming applications
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive production applications such as real-time coding assistants, chatbots, and document processing pipelines

models.name: Qwen3
models.popularity_notes: The Qwen model family has been adopted by over 90,000 enterprises across consumer electronics, gaming, and other sectors, making it the most widely deployed LLM family in enterprise settings outside of Western providers.
strengths: Exceptional multilingual performance especially for Asian languages
Open weights with strong commercial licensing
Broad enterprise adoption validated across 90,000+ deployments
Competitive coding and reasoning benchmarks
Cost-efficient inference at scale
models.best_for: Enterprise deployments requiring strong multilingual support, Asian-market applications, and cost-efficient self-hosted inference at scale

models.name: Grok-3 / Grok-4
models.popularity_notes: Grok holds 2.4% of global generative AI web traffic as of August 2026 and benefits from deep integration with X (formerly Twitter), with Grok 4.1 Fast noted for leading 2-million-token context capabilities among API providers.
strengths: Industry-leading 2 million token context window eliminating chunking strategies
Real-time information access through X platform integration
Strong performance on STEM and scientific reasoning tasks
Rapidly improving benchmark trajectory
Unique real-time social data access
models.best_for: Applications requiring real-time information, ultra-long document processing, and STEM-focused research assistance

models.name: Mistral Small 4
models.popularity_notes: Mistral models maintain strong adoption among European developers and self-hosters, with Mistral Small 4 offering a rare combination of instruction following, reasoning, and coding in one Apache 2.0 licensed model at highly competitive pricing of $0.15/$0.60 per million tokens.
strengths: Apache 2.0 license enabling unrestricted commercial use
Unified instruct, reasoning, and coding capabilities in one model
Very competitive pricing among commercial API offerings
Strong European regulatory compliance posture
Large 256,000 token context window for its size class
models.best_for: European enterprise deployments requiring data sovereignty, cost-efficient fine-tuning projects, and teams needing a permissively licensed multipurpose model

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.popularity_notes: GPT-6 Astra leads on the hardest math, reasoning, and cybersecurity benchmarks per September 2026 evaluations and is gaining rapid adoption among professional developers and researchers requiring frontier-level performance despite premium pricing.
strengths: Top-tier performance on advanced mathematics and reasoning benchmarks
Leading cybersecurity and adversarial task evaluations
Backed by OpenAI's dominant enterprise distribution network
Ideal for the most demanding agentic and research workloads
Strong tool-use and multi-step planning capabilities
models.best_for: Research institutions, advanced agentic systems, and enterprise teams requiring best-available performance on complex reasoning, math, and security tasks
